title: RISE Changes: play a listed team's digests on rise.syberlabs.io
acceptance: /changes/<slug> lists, and /changes/<slug>/<id> shows and plays, the digests of a team listed in src/core/changes/listed.js, read from that team's own changes-data branch and named by its brand.

The Worker fetches /content/changes/<slug>/<file> from raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/changes-data/ only for a listed slug; every other slug, path or method is a 404 that never reaches upstream. RISE's own /changes and /content/changes/<file> are unchanged.
A team is listed only with another team's owner/name repository and a brand its company has confirmed in brands.js; nothing is listed until one is.

A team's digest is held to the same contract as RISE's, with its pull request links checked against the team's own repository; a digest linking any other repository, RISE's included, is refused and not played.
The first load carries no brand data: the slug grammar lives with the address parser, and the list and brands load only with the changes page.

evidence.note: Branch claude/project-thread-4c3484, local (Linux, Node 22): changes page, listed teams, Worker files, route, figures, quality and scripts/changes: 22 files, 509 passed; system-design fails on a generated catalog path missing in this checkout, as on main. vite build clean; first load 63.4 KB br of a 64.0 KB budget.

activity.summary: Opened from the owner's ask to put RISE Changes in production, read as RISE playing listed teams' digests (gateway framing, option A).

summary: rise.syberlabs.io can play a listed team's weekly digest at /changes/<slug>, from that team's own branch. No team is listed until a company confirms its brand.
